item_verdicts.write_paths: the node's declared write path is the reports directory; report.md is written there and no product-code path is touched, the scripts and logs sitting under the run directory as the brief directs.

justifications.durability: the node adds no test and changes no code, so no new assertion guards it; its correctness rests on reckon/crew/review.py:2172, a repository-owned function with its own tests, while measure.sh's two-arm procedure is unguarded.
justifications.evidence: base_arm.log and cand_arm.log each carry their literal command on the header line and a bare EXIT=1, and I reproduced added_failures_from_gate_logs -> (1, [the one id]) plus the summary lines from those two logs; the added file defines 5 tests, reconciling 459 vs 464.
justifications.fit: measure.sh and write_manifest.py follow the idiom of the sibling population-at-merge node run earlier today and name nothing the repository naming rules forbid.
justifications.goal_fidelity: report.md:9-11 answers the brief's question with the single added id and its per-arm counts, and report.md:24-27 names the base-absent file and the follower-pane verdict the brief asked for.
